values.note: In season (water-park season) $49 a night for water and 30/50 amps, $59 full hookups, for 2 people; $9 per extra person (2 and under free). Before and after the water-park season 20% off: $39.20 / $47.20, extras included. Weekly: 7th night free. The $8 online reservation fee is non-refundable, once per reservation (CampLife's October 2026 one-night quote was $47.20 = $39.20 + $8). Swimming in the lake is included for campers; visitors pay admission. Read 2026-10-30.

note: Family-owned (since 1954) campground and water park at 8777 Manchester Ave. SW, Navarre, near Ohio's largest Amish community: level, chip-and-seal sites for large RVs. Families only, no alcohol anywhere in the park; swimming in the treated lake is included in summer, and catch-and-release fishing at set hours. --Claude
